projects.title: AI Investor – Multi-Agent Trading System
description: Developed a multi-agent trading system as part of MSc Computer Science thesis, integrating LLM-driven agents specialized in market sentiment, technical indicators, and risk management.
Each agent collaborated to generate and validate trading signals, forming consensus before execution.
Tested on simulated and historical stock market data to evaluate profitability, risk, and decision efficiency.

metrics.performance: Outperformed baseline strategies in Sharpe ratio and drawdown
metrics.impact: Demonstrated viability of LLM-based multi-agent trading

challenges: Coordinating reasoning across multiple autonomous agents
Managing inconsistent LLM outputs in volatile data conditions
Designing effective evaluation metrics for trading strategies
solutions: Implemented collaborative agent architecture using LangChain’s multi-agent framework
Introduced consensus-based decision logic for reliable trade signals
Used vectorbt for efficient backtesting and performance visualization

results.title: Signal Quality
results.description: Agents produced more consistent buy/sell signals compared to single-model baselines

results.title: Risk Reduction
results.description: Reduced simulated portfolio drawdown through consensus filtering

results.title: Research Outcome
results.description: Validated potential of multi-agent LLM frameworks in algorithmic trading environments

projects.title: LLM-Powered Research Assistant
description: Created a research assistant capable of reading and reasoning over academic papers using LangChain, Ollama, Qdrant, and Elasticsearch.
Implemented ingestion pipelines for paper datasets and vector search APIs for contextual retrieval.
Enabled users to query, summarize, and compare research insights through natural language.

metrics.performance: Improved retrieval relevance by combining vector and keyword search

challenges: Balancing semantic and keyword-based search precision
Running local LLMs with low-latency responses
solutions: Used Qdrant for high-performance vector storage and similarity search
Integrated Elasticsearch for full-text indexing and hybrid retrieval
Optimized Ollama inference pipelines for responsive local reasoning

results.title: Research Efficiency
results.description: Enabled users to find and summarize relevant papers up to 10x faster

results.title: System Architecture
results.description: Deployed modular RAG system supporting scalable dataset ingestion

results.title: Practical Utility
results.description: Used by peers to prepare literature reviews and research comparisons

projects.title: Resume Analyser and Job Tracker
description: Developed an intelligent resume management platform where users upload resumes, track job applications, and receive ATS compatibility scores.
Integrated Google Gemini API for semantic analysis and skill extraction to match job descriptions.
Built modular React frontend with a Laravel backend and REST APIs.

metrics.impact: Improved job matching and applicant tracking experience

challenges: Parsing unstructured resumes in multiple formats
Accurately mapping extracted skills to diverse job requirements
Providing meaningful ATS score explanations to users
solutions: Used Google Gemini API for document understanding and relevance scoring
Implemented scalable REST API for resume analysis and job tracking
Built ATS scoring model combining keyword match and semantic similarity

results.title: Automation
results.description: Reduced manual resume screening time significantly

results.title: Accuracy
results.description: Achieved over 90% alignment between resumes and job descriptions

results.title: User Experience
results.description: Enhanced candidate visibility and tracking workflow
